name: Dog House | Party Animalz
description:
Lemon Cherry Gelato x Z Animal | Candy, Gas

Party Animalz brings a punchy hit of lemon-candy sweetness over a smooth cookie-dough finish. The aroma is loud and sweet with just a hint of spice. Dense, frosty buds with streaks of purple.
